transcript.text: Thank you all for joining. I've called this meeting because we've received repeated concerns across the department about three issues: public corrections, after-hours requests, and unclear ownership of meeting decisions. Our current department guidance doesn't actually specify how any of these must be handled, and I have the authority to issue a department-wide communication charter to address them. Before I draft anything, though, I want to follow our established practice: I'll consult with each of you — line management, employees, team leadership, and Employee Relations — and I'll need each participant to give a recorded fact report using the meeting's formal report function. I'll wait for every report before I make any decisions. So please, let's begin: what do each of you know or have observed regarding these three concerns?
